episodes.synopsis: An old man speaks of a golden city that lies within a devouring abyss somewhere in uncharted waters. One explorer may be the key to finding both.
episodes.title: The Compass Pointed to the Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Riko, Reg and Nanachi take their first steps into the sixth layer. Both wonders and dangers await the trio, but they are unaware they are being watched.
episodes.title: Capital of the Unreturned

episodes.synopsis: Riko couldn’t have known the consequences of her words, but she sealed the villager’s fate as soon as she acknowledged Meinya was priceless. The Balancing has begun…
episodes.title: Village of the Hollows

episodes.synopsis: Faputa and Reg once knew each other, but Reg cannot remember her at all now. Meanwhile, Nanachi is stunned by news so unexpected that it should be impossible to believe.
episodes.title: Friend

episodes.synopsis: Some say there’s a secret hidden deep within the dark cave at the edge of the village. Villagers don’t investigate and stay far away, but Riko isn’t a villager.
episodes.title: Concealment

episodes.synopsis: The villagers must lure abyssal fauna into the village to hunt them. But when one creature proves too much to handle, Riko needs to help the villagers defend their home.
episodes.title: The Luring

episodes.synopsis: What happened to the expedition? The truth is far more tragic and horrifying than anyone could have imagined.
episodes.title: The Cradle of Desire

episodes.synopsis: They had their reasons for descending into that infernal pit. They found damnation and salvation in equal measure.
episodes.title: The Form the Wish Takes

episodes.synopsis: Faputa can help Reg save Nanachi, but everything has a price. In exchange, Reg must help her enter the village.
episodes.title: The Return

episodes.synopsis: The reckoning comes, but Reg is too kind and foolish to be a bystander.
episodes.title: All That You Gather

episodes.synopsis: The village’s membrane has been breached, and through the gap floods chaos itself. But as attackers enter from without, aid comes from within.
episodes.title: Value

episodes.synopsis: In the end, everything comes full circle.
episodes.title: Gold
